bagPolicy.summary: Only small bags and handbags no larger than 21cm x 30cm x 19cm (A4) are allowed. Large bags are not allowed into the venue.
allowed: Small bags up to 21cm x 30cm x 19cm (A4)
prohibited: Cans and bottles, including reusable water bottles
bagPolicy.note: Guests with a large bag are directed to the back entrance, where it may be searched or refused. If accepted, it must be stored for £3. A cloakroom (£3 per item) runs for standing shows.

parking.note: The Brighton Centre does not operate a dedicated public car park. Use current venue travel guidance and nearby municipal or commercial parking information, and allow extra time for seafront traffic.
lots: Sainsbury's Brighton, New England St Car Park

rideshare.note: The nearest taxi rank is at the bottom of West Street outside the Odeon Cinema. Private-hire vehicles must be booked.

concessions.note: The Brighton Centre offers a variety of food and drink options for visitors. While specific vendors are not listed, the venue provides a range of refreshments to enhance the event experience. Special offerings or highlights are not detailed on the website.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Public areas are fully accessible for wheelchair users except the East and West Balconies. There are accessible toilets, lifts, accessible viewing platforms for standing and seated shows, and lowered counters at the bars, merchandise stand, and Event Box Office.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: On event days, the Event Box Office opens 2.5 hours before doors for ticket queries and collections and stays open until the main act goes on stage. After that, tickets for collection are left with a steward at the front entrance on Kings Road.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The main entrance is at the front on Kings Road, and the back entrance on Russell Road is generally quieter. Doors usually open at 6:30pm, but times can change, so check your event page.
